FN-ZA3FKKW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 120
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kerry Underwood
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 120 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Genetic
Counseling until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
